dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Periorbital hyperpigmentation (constitutional/genetic), exacerbated by chronic sleep deprivation

Alternatives:
1. Allergic shiners (atopic or contact dermatitis-related periorbital darkening)
2. Periorbital edema with tear trough deformity producing shadowing
3. Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (e.g., from prior dermatitis or rubbing)
